lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The students came back to school after the National Day holiday.
lines.chinese: 国庆节假期后，学生们回到了学校。

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: Hello, Liu Tao! Where did you go for the holiday? I called you, but you weren't at home.
lines.chinese: 你好，刘涛！你去哪里度假了？我给你打了电话，但你不在家。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: I went to Shanghai and visited my aunt.
lines.chinese: 我去了上海，拜访了我的姑姑。

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: What did you do there?
lines.chinese: 你在那里做了什么？

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: We went to the Bund and visited the Shanghai Museum. I saw many interesting things.
lines.chinese: 我们去了外滩，参观了上海博物馆。我看到了很多有趣的东西。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: How was your holiday, Mike?
lines.chinese: 你的假期怎么样，迈克？

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: It was great fun. Our family went to a farm near Star Lake. We picked some oranges and went fishing.
lines.chinese: 很有趣。我们一家去了星湖附近的一个农场。我们摘了一些橘子，还去钓了鱼。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: Did you catch any fish?
lines.chinese: 你抓到鱼了吗？

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: Yes, I did. I caught a big fish!
lines.chinese: 是的，我抓到了。我抓到了一条大鱼！

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: That's great. Why did you call me?
lines.chinese: 太棒了。你为什么给我打电话？

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: Because I wanted to give you the fish.
lines.chinese: 因为我想把鱼给你。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: Where's the fish now?
lines.chinese: 现在鱼在哪里？

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: I ate it!
lines.chinese: 我吃了！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It is time for dinner. Bobby comes home late.
lines.chinese: 到吃晚饭的时间了。博比回家晚了。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Where did you go, Bobby?
lines.chinese: 你去哪里了，博比？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I was in the park. We had a fashion show there.
lines.chinese: 我在公园。我们在那里举办了一场时装表演。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Tina loves beautiful clothes. She is excited about the show.
lines.chinese: 蒂娜喜欢漂亮的衣服。她对这场表演很兴奋。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Wow, I love fashion shows! What did you wear, Bobby?
lines.chinese: 哇，我喜欢时装表演！你穿了什么，博比？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I wore a paper T-shirt and paper shorts.
lines.chinese: 我穿了一件纸T恤和纸短裤。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Ha! Ha! That's cool. What great fun!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！太酷了。多好玩啊！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Tina asks Bobby about Sam.
lines.chinese: 蒂娜问博比关于萨姆的事。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Did Sam wear paper clothes too?
lines.chinese: 萨姆也穿了纸衣服吗？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: No. He wore a lot of bottles.
lines.chinese: 没有。他穿了很多瓶子。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Wow, that's interesting!
lines.chinese: 哇，好有趣！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Tina asks about the show.
lines.chinese: 蒂娜问关于表演的事。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Did the show go well?
lines.chinese: 表演进行得顺利吗？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: It was wonderful at first, but then there was heavy rain.
lines.chinese: 一开始很精彩，但是后来下了大雨。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Oh, that's too bad!
lines.chinese: 哦，那太糟糕了！
